title: Western Star 6900 series Road Train FUPS Bullbar #13
description: Western Star Texas style FUPS 5 post hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar for 6900 series trucks. Optional oversize signs, reversible Road Train/ Oversize signs, numberplate mount and blue powder coat. Other colours available on request. Cow catcher with five small uprights. Optional steel plate over tow hitch. Built with extra pipe at top and 88mm pipe.
